t: A Tale of Two Physics: Unifying Server and Notebook Worlds
s: This article chronicles the technical challenge of making the Pipulate tool function seamlessly in both a structured server environment (FastHTML, Starlette) and an interactive Jupyter Notebook setting. It emphasizes the need for clear, code-based communication with AI, overcoming its amnesiac nature by providing concrete examples of working code to establish 'physics' and guide its behavior.
sub: Bridging server and notebook environments for Pipulate
Communicating with AI using 'hard language' (code) over 'soft language' (natural text)
Overcoming AI amnesia with concrete code examples and strong evidence
Python's dynamic typing and its implications for reliability and AI interaction
Using code patterns (FastHTML/FastLite vs. FastAPI/SQLAlchemy) to constrain AI behavior
